evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'So, I can see here that you are moving from a one story house' and launches directly into probing without the 10-15 minute time-box framing or promise of a dependable quote. No wait for affirmation either.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into logistics probing: 'are we moving like the entire house or you know just partial.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides: 'a typical like, you know, one bedroom bedrooms worth of items usually takes two movers, one truck between two and a half to three and a half hours to completely move. So, in your case...I would estimate your move to be between like two and a half to three and a half hours' and personalizes to one-story to one-story with drive time.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covers trip fee ($175), states 'no hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no stairwell fees. No assembly assembly fees.' Also covers 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments: 'the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Never asked. Rep jumps to explicit ask without 'does that feel fair?' and without holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Rep states: 'if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Covers the discount terms clearly.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Rep says: 'we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages' and 'included in the hourly rate.' Missing the explicit 'no deductible/no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or similar confirmation. Moves straight to explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks: 'would you like our help with your upcoming move this Monday October 5th?' — asked plainly without a built-in out.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms: 'Monday October 5th between 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM' (date and arrival window). Rep also takes note of bed disassembly/reassembly detail. Missing: explicit phone number confirmation, crew size confirmation, both addresses re-confirmed in booking summary.

top_strength: Rep gathered discovery basics cleanly (moving date, both addresses, size/contents, access) and provided a well-anchored, personalized estimate with complete pricing transparency including trip fee and 2.5-hour minimum framing.
coaching_note: You skipped Section 2 entirely — never asked 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — and skipped the 'does that feel fair?' check before asking for the business; add both to your next call to stay on script.
